title: Emergency procedures.
partHeading: PART IV. ADMISSION TO PSYCHIATRIC FACILITY
bodyText:
PART IV. ADMISSION TO PSYCHIATRIC FACILITY

The emergency procedures in this subpart shall consist of emergency transportation, emergency examination, and emergency hospitalization for individuals who may be mentally ill or suffering from substance abuse and imminently dangerous to self or others.
